Thanks for the ping, Mateo.

Recommendation:
1) Approve a one-week rebaseline to June 25. Keeps momentum and is defensible to execs.
2) Offer a limited SLA fallback (99.0) for the first 30 days post-onboarding if Acme needs a soft-start; include a token-credit schedule: 15% service credit for any calendar-week where P99 latency exceeds our target by >25%.
3) Add a clause that the full SLA (99.5) is reinstated automatically once SOC 2 evidence is accepted and the model-lock milestone is reached (proposed: June 20).

Suggested customer wording (short):
"We recommend a short rebaseline to June 25 to accommodate procurement. To enable a soft start while you complete legal/provider checks, Redwood can temporarily move to a reduced SLA of 99.0 for up to 30 days with a predefined credit schedule. Full SLA terms will resume upon evidence acceptance and model-lock."

Attaching a draft for legal review: SLA_fallback_draft.docx.
